laws.rule: Hirosaki City accommodation tax: JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) at hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku in the city, collected by the lodging. School trips and nursery or kindergarten events (with their supervisors) are exempt. The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications consented on 22 July 2025, with the ordinance set to take effect on 1 December 2025.

laws.rule: Aomori Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (青森県青少年健全育成条例), art. 24. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to sunrise. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902) or a petty fine (kayo). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.

layers.process: Private cars are kept off National Route 102 through the Oirase Gorge on set days. In 2026 the restriction ran 7 to 13 September, 10:00 to 16:00 on weekdays and 9:00 to 16:00 on holidays. On 13 September large vehicles, specified medium vehicles and taxis were also stopped. A paid shuttle ran between the Oirase Keiryu Onsen Ski Area parking area and the Kyuya parking area. The event page shows it as ended and lists no later dates for 2026.
